peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 6.3% above its local comparables; 77 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (21.8): 3.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 23 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 75% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2012.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

bands.positionText: near the peer median (its range includes it)
near the peer median (its range includes it)

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $813,000 ($1,736 psf, 462–473 sq ft; 6 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,626 psf (range $1,492–1,703); 6.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $52,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,299,000 ($1,700 psf, 764 sq ft; 6 resales, Jul 2025–Jun 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,608 psf (range $1,417–1,771); 5.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $70,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Punggol LRT about 240 m, Punggol MRT about 240 m; closer than 87 of 116 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 5 within 1 km and 17 within 2 km; nearest Punggol View Primary School about 190 m; more than 105 of 116 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 220 m), more than 116 of 116 similar developments; nearest hawker centre One Punggol Hawker Centre about 570 m; nearest park Punggol Waterway Park about 440 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 21 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 543 resales (543 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 543 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 89 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 543 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 626 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13.3%). Planning-area private resales −7.7%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
